HEADLINE: In terms of Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, this is to inform that the meeting of the Board of Directors of M/s. Sparc Electrex Limited was held today on 14th September, ....
MORE:
In terms of Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, this is to inform that the meeting of the Board of Directors of M/s. Sparc Electrex Limited was held today on 14th September, 2026 on Saturday at the Registered office of the Company at 03.00 p.m. and concluded at around 04.40 p.m. The Board considered and approved as follows.

1. The Un-audited Standalone Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026 along with Limited Review Report thereon pursuant to Regulation 33 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.                

2. Appointed Mrs. Kamini Niravkumar Joshi (DIN: 12039959) as an Additional Director (Non-Executive and Non-Independent) of the Company.

3. Took note on compliances made under SEBI (Listing Obligation & Disclosure Requirement) Regulations, 2015 for the quarter ended 30th September, 2026.

Please take the same on records.
